title: MemCast: Memory-Driven Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Conditioned Reasoning

claim.summary: MemCast accumulates historical patterns, reasoning wisdom and constraints from training cases, then retrieves them to explore and validate forecast trajectories without retraining parameters.

modules.name: Outcome-derived hierarchical forecasting memory
modules.scope_reason: The memory is distilled from forecast outcomes and trajectories and conditions future predictions.

modules.name: Wisdom-scored forecast exploration and constraint repair
modules.scope_reason: Candidate trajectories predict future sequences and are selected/repaired against forecast experience and output feasibility.
